tasks.short: Assess risk of harm to self or others

steps.what: Read existing patient information relevant to assessments of harm risk
Interview and observe the patient during the harm-risk assessment
Conduct the clinical assessment of harm risk and determine required clinical response
outputs: clinical risk formulation and response decision

steps.what: Write the actual harm-risk assessment, uncertainty and clinical response decision
inputs: clinical risk formulation and response decision

steps.what: Save the patient's completed harm-risk assessment in the existing record

tasks.design: Use a direct native view of existing risk-related history and the current assessment-note structure in the care record {OTHER}. The psychologist conducts the interview, makes the clinical formulation and records the actual uncertainty and response decision without automated risk scoring.
tasks.previous_blocker: Record navigation and repeated note headings surround the substantive risk assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record views and fields can remove navigation and layout while preserving the full clinical assessment.
tasks.still_hard: Risk can change quickly and cannot be inferred reliably from a form or past record alone.
tasks.human_edge: Attend to the person's actual situation and take responsibility for an appropriate clinical response.

ambition.what: Risk formulation and response decisions remain clinical responsibilities.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native record views and assessment-note fields can reduce clerical risk-assessment work while the interview, formulation and response remain clinical judgement.

assumptions: OTHER means the existing care record and clinical encounter. Boundary includes the real assessment note; it is not a diagnosis engine or an automated crisis response.

Prior treating clinicians produce existing history. The psychologist reads it in s1, elicits evidence in s2, decides in s3 and captures the actual formulation in s4. No structured risk data or recording is supplied free.

s1 removes three units of record navigation, retaining12 for reading. s4 removes1.4 units of repeated headings, retaining12.6 for actual formulation and checks. All70 interview and judgement units remain.

Existing urgent-care duties remain unchanged and no delay for software is introduced. Ordinary same-record author save is tiny, fully retained and ungated; no self-approval is added. Native functions already used earn no additional benefit.
unknowns: Current record navigation and assessment template
research_questions: Does the view preserve conflicting and time-sensitive evidence rather than hiding it in a summary?

already_counted.description: Read history, interview, assess risk, write the actual note and save

incremental.description: Maintain the history view and assessment-note fields

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R95.6 gross4.4 less upkeep1 gives3.4. For a complex case needing fresh history review and bespoke formulation, reading retains14.5 of15 and writing13.5 of14; interview45, judgement25 and save1 remain. Gross1 is offset by upkeep1, giving low0.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Document clinical notes and treatment plans

steps.what: Capture the actual patient information, session observations and clinician-selected recommendations
Assemble verified patient and session fields in the documentation draft
inputs: existing verified patient identity and session date

steps.what: Draft session notes, progress notes and the clinician-selected treatment plan narrative

loop.purpose: Turn the clinician's captured facts and decisions into a structured note
loop.input: clinician-authored brief and verified identity and session fields
loop.output: draft notes preserving attribution, uncertainty and clinician-selected plan
loop.check: Psychologist checks every clinical assertion, omission, attribution and plan against the actual brief and session in s4
loop.stop: Two drafting attempts maximum; unsupported or ambiguous content returns to funded manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates provide fields but do not organise the encounter-specific narrative without repeating manual prose

steps.what: Read and correct all patient notes and treatment-plan wording for clinical meaning
Save the completed patient notes in the existing clinical record

tasks.design: Reuse verified patient fields in the care-record tool {OTHER} and draft narrative only from the psychologist's actual session brief. The psychologist corrects every clinical meaning and plan before the ordinary record save; the helper never chooses treatment.
tasks.previous_blocker: The clinician's captured facts and decisions are repeatedly expanded into structured documentation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native field reuse plus a bounded narrative loop can remove re-entry and prose assembly while retaining semantic review.
tasks.still_hard: Incorrect attribution, omitted uncertainty or an altered plan can materially misrepresent care.
tasks.human_edge: Know what happened and ensure the record accurately represents the patient and the clinical decision.

ambition.what: Documentation accuracy and treatment decisions remain with the psychologist.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: verified record fields and a clinician-authored brief can support bounded note drafting, with clinical meaning and treatment plans checked by the psychologist.

assumptions: OTHER means the existing care-record authoring tool. Boundary is documentation after actual care, not session delivery, treatment selection, prescribing or an outward clinical letter.

The psychologist produces and checks the facts, observations and selected plan in s1. Registration and the actual session record supply verified patient id and date. No free transcript, ambient recording or prestructured clinical assessment is presumed.

s2 replaces repeated factual field entry; s3 replaces expansion of the captured brief into prose. Native forms are tested first and existing runtime is not a saving. Missing field mappings and failed drafts have funded manual repair.

s4 retains all24 units of actual semantic correction, including omissions and attribution. The final one-unit author save is an ordinary internal write, fully retained and ungated; it is not a new self-approval stage.
Processing must use the provider's actual authorised health-data environment. If that access is unavailable, narrative drafting remains manual rather than exporting patient data elsewhere.
unknowns: Actual approved drafting and record access
research_questions: Can review detect omitted uncertainty and distinguish patient statements from clinician observations?

already_counted.description: Capture actual clinical facts, correct all note meaning and save

incremental.description: Maintain note mappings and manually repair missing fields or failed narrative drafts

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R50 gross50 less upkeep8 gives42. For an ambiguous session with sparse verified fields, field assembly retains12 of15 and narrative writing28 of35; capture25, correction24 and save1 remain. Gross10 less upkeep8 gives2. No save runtime or treatment-decision benefit is claimed.

tasks.short: Identify issues and diagnose psychological disorders

steps.what: Read records and reference materials relevant to the psychological issues
Enter and verify actual psychological test responses and applicable test version
Calculate specified psychological test totals from the verified responses and norm tables
inputs: licensed applicable scoring and norm tables

steps.what: Conduct interviews to understand the actual psychological, emotional and behavioral issues
Interpret the information, identify issues and diagnose disorders where supported
Write the actual psychological formulation and diagnostic uncertainty in the record
Save the actual diagnostic information in the existing patient record

tasks.design: Use native record navigation and licensed fixed test scoring in the clinical tools {OTHER}, with reference materials in {DOCS}. The psychologist verifies inputs, interprets the scores alongside interviews and records the actual diagnostic formulation; no model diagnoses disorders.
tasks.previous_blocker: Record navigation and manual fixed-score arithmetic surround diagnostic judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native scoring tables and record views can remove clerical work without converting scores into diagnoses.
tasks.still_hard: Test applicability, conflicting evidence and differential diagnosis need qualified clinical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Interpret the whole person's context rather than equating a score with a disorder.

ambition.what: Diagnostic authority remains with the psychologist.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed psychological test totals can be calculated against applicable scoring tables while clinical interpretation and diagnosis remain qualified human work.

assumptions: OTHER means the existing clinical record and licensed test-scoring tool. Boundary includes actual response entry, scoring, diagnostic interview and its real formulation note. Test administration is a separate completed activity, not removed or newly transferred.

The qualified administrator produces the real responses and version record. The psychologist enters and verifies response id, value, missingness and version in s2. Licensed test materials supply the applicable scoring and norm tables, whose applicability is checked in retained clinical judgement.

s1 removes three units of record navigation, retaining17 for reading. s3 replaces actual manual fixed-score arithmetic only; a score does not select a diagnosis. Missing responses or incompatible norm tables require funded manual repair.
The formulation write9 and ordinary save1 remain fully retained and ungated. Native scoring already used earns no new benefit; access, licensing and suitability of the actual tool need confirmation.
unknowns: Actual tests and licensed scoring route
research_questions: Can every computed score expose its test version, missing-response handling and norm reference?

already_counted.description: Read evidence, enter responses, interview, interpret, write and save the actual formulation

incremental.description: Maintain licensed scoring references and manually repair missing responses or incompatible tables

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R87 gross13 less upkeep3 gives10. With an uncommon test version requiring manual score reconciliation, scoring retains7 of10 and record reading19 of20; all70 other units remain. Gross4 less upkeep3 gives1. No diagnostic or ordinary-save benefit is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write client reports and maintain paperwork

steps.what: Verify the purpose, permitted recipient and required content of the client report
Copy the relevant verified client facts and source references into the report draft
Write the client report narrative from the actual documented clinical conclusions
outputs: complete report draft and addressed recipient

loop.purpose: Draft the requested report without adding clinical conclusions
loop.input: source-linked documented facts, conclusions and permitted report scope
loop.output: complete draft with attribution, limitations and source references
loop.check: Psychologist reads every claim, omission and disclosure against the source record and permitted purpose in s4
loop.stop: Two drafts maximum; unsupported conclusions or unsuitable disclosure return to funded manual report writing
loop.why_not_simpler: The client-specific narrative needs language assembly beyond fixed report fields; native templates are used for structure first

steps.what: Check and correct the complete client report for clinical meaning and permitted disclosure
inputs: complete report draft and addressed recipient

steps.what: Send only the validated client report to the verified permitted recipient
Maintain the required report paperwork and actual disclosure reference

tasks.design: Assemble source-linked report facts from the existing care record {OTHER} into {DOCS}, then use a bounded loop for the narrative only. The psychologist validates clinical meaning and permitted disclosure before the exact report is sent through the existing secure route in {OTHER}, with actual paperwork retained.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing record facts and clinical conclusions are copied and rewritten into requested reports.
tasks.enabler_now: Native report fields plus bounded narrative drafting can remove repeated assembly while retaining clinician review.
tasks.still_hard: A true clinical fact can still be inappropriate to disclose for a particular report purpose.
tasks.human_edge: Take responsibility for report meaning, uncertainty and appropriate disclosure.

ambition.what: Clinical report responsibility stays with the psychologist.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-linked report assembly and bounded drafting can reduce repeated clinical report writing, with meaning and disclosure checked by the clinician.

assumptions: OTHER means the existing clinical record and secure report exchange. Boundary is an actually requested report and its required paperwork, not a new report for every clinical session.

Treating clinicians already produce the clinical source notes and conclusions. s1 counts request, identity and disclosure checking. s2 copies those verified source fields; no new diagnostic conclusion or free transcript is assumed.

s3 drafts narrative from existing conclusions only. Missing record fields and failed narratives require funded manual repair. Native report templates are tested first, and existing runtime earns no saving.

s4 retains29 units of actual clinical and disclosure correction of the assembled draft. It is substantive validation before an external clinical report release, not an extra self-approval of an ordinary author save. The gate binds the exact final wording, attachments and recipient; edits require revalidation.

The actual send retains its current tiny time. s6 removes one unit of repeated report index fields, retaining four for real required paperwork and checks; ordinary same-record saves are fully retained and ungated. Any approved health-data processing route must be established before model use.
unknowns: Actual report purposes and disclosure workflow
research_questions: Can review detect an accurate but unnecessary clinical detail before it reaches the report recipient?

already_counted.description: Verify report scope, validate all meaning and disclosure, send and maintain actual paperwork

incremental.description: Maintain source and report mappings and manually repair missing fields or failed narratives

approvals.approved_version: Exact final report wording, attachments and permitted recipient clinically validated in s4; edits void release approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R44 gross56 less upkeep10 gives46. For a report with complex attribution and nonstandard source records, fact copying retains19 of25, narrative writing23 of30 and paperwork5 of5; scope10, validation29 and send1 remain. Gross13 less upkeep10 gives3. No saving comes from the send runtime or an ordinary author save.

role.altitude: The psychologist retains risk, diagnosis and treatment judgement while reducing repeated documentation and report assembly.
reach: Maintain clinically accurate source records for appropriate report use
skills_to_grow: Verify attribution and uncertainty in drafts
role.ambitious_version: The psychologist gives attentive clinical care with accurate, carefully checked documentation and reports that preserve the limits of the evidence.
